faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Manager- Incubation post at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Assistant Manager- Incubation post at IIT Gandhinagar is 25 August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Manager- Incubation role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an undergraduate degree (BE/ B. Tech.) from a recognized Institution to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are required for the Assistant Manager- Incubation position?
faq.answer: A minimum of two years of post-qualification experience in the incubation ecosystem is required for the Assistant Manager- Incubation role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Manager- Incubation post is below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager- Incubation post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay for the Assistant Manager- Incubation position ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 78,000.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Assistant Manager- Incubation recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Gandhinagar or via the direct application link provided in the important links section.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Manager- Incubation post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Manager- Incubation post will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Manager- Incubation position is Contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
